description: This file implements a random number generator class 'rng' with methods for generating, storing, and retrieving random values, as well as managing a global rng instance and related functions.

classes.name: rng
classes.description: A class for managing random number generation with support for nested random configurations and result storage.

classes.name: set_random_generator
classes.description: A RAII class for setting and restoring the global rng instance.

methods.name: rng::get_random
methods.description: Returns a random integer, either from stored values or by generating a new one.

methods.name: rng::get_random_results
methods.description: Returns the 'results' configuration node associated with the rng.

methods.name: rng::set_random_results
methods.description: Stores a given configuration as the 'results' for the rng.

methods.name: rng::add_random_separator
methods.description: Sets a flag to add a separator in the random sequence.

methods.name: rng::set_random
methods.description: Sets the 'random' configuration node and resets state.

methods.name: set_random_generator::set_random_generator
methods.description: Constructor that sets the global rng instance.

methods.name: set_random_generator::~set_random_generator
methods.description: Destructor that restores the previous global rng instance.

methods.name: get_random
methods.description: Returns a random integer from the global rng.

methods.name: get_random_results
methods.description: Retrieves the 'results' configuration from the global rng.

methods.name: set_random_results
methods.description: Sets the 'results' configuration in the global rng.

methods.name: add_random_separator
methods.description: Adds a separator in the global rng sequence.
